notes: P04 task DSN-X03_fault_windows (RQ1): deterministic fault-injection controller enumerating the named crash cut points across one commit lifecycle for the DSN 2027 recoverable-safety-journal study. evaluation/venue2027/dsn/fault_windows.py defines the canonical five-stage lifecycle (INTENT -> WAL_WRITE -> APPLY -> PERSIST_RECEIPT -> OUTBOX_DELIVER, mapping the manifest barriers SQL flush / commit ACK / outbox enqueue / broker publish / consumer ack) and five named windows: BEFORE_WAL (anchor WAL_WRITE, DSN-CASE-02: nothing durable anywhere), AFTER_WAL_BEFORE_APPLY (anchor APPLY, unapplied WAL is not a committed mutation), AFTER_APPLY_BEFORE_RECEIPT (anchor PERSIST_RECEIPT, DSN-CASE-03 unknown-response reconciliation), AFTER_RECEIPT (anchor OUTBOX_DELIVER, DSN-CASE-03/07 pending delivery) and DOUBLE_FAULT (two crashes in one lifecycle: first crash at the earliest reachable single-window barrier, deterministic restart, second CrashInjected crash_number=2 propagates to the caller; repeated kill/restart adversarial control). Injection uses named synchronization barriers, never sleep-based causal guesses and no randomness: the LifecycleRun recorder arms one window; crossing the armed anchor barrier raises CrashInjected inside record_stage at that exact cut point, the anchor stage is never recorded, and the crash is sticky for the attempt (a SIGKILLed process cannot record further stages). API: enumerate_fault_windows(ops) -> list[FaultWindow] (manifest signature enumerate_windows alias provided) and run_with_window(window, fn, lifecycle=...), which never returns normally: it injects or refuses. Fail-closed refusal semantics with 10 stable reason codes (UNKNOWN_STAGE, DUPLICATE_STAGE, DUPLICATE_WINDOW, WINDOW_CATALOG_MISMATCH, WINDOW_NOT_REACHABLE, UNORDERED_LIFECYCLE, DOUBLE_FAULT_UNREACHABLE, EMPTY_LIFECYCLE, LIFECYCLE_REQUIRED, MALFORMED_CRASH_RECORD): a window whose anchor barrier is absent from the lifecycle is refused at enumeration AND injection time rather than silently skipped (no partial enumeration can masquerade as a complete schedule); a lifecycle that completes without crossing the armed barrier is refused dynamically (missed injection can never count as a pass); duplicate windows in the catalog are detected via WINDOW_ORDER/WINDOW_ANCHOR integrity checks before every enumeration; duplicate, unknown and reordered stages are refused; DOUBLE_FAULT without a reachable barrier or without an explicit lifecycle is refused. FaultWindow/LifecycleRun/CrashInjected are typed, JSON-serializable, with lossless to_dict/from_dict round-trips; the CrashInjected exception carries the ordered run transcript so callers reconstruct the durable prefix without introspecting candidate internals (oracle independence). test_fault_windows.py: 35 tests (stdlib pytest only, no third-party deps, no DB/network) -- positive: full lifecycle enumerates all five windows exactly once in canonical order with documented anchors and CASE_MATRIX refs; every single window actually injected at its barrier with anchor stage never recorded and all prior stages recorded on the transcript; DOUBLE_FAULT injects two observable crashes (harness observes crash #1, records recovery/restart, crash #2 propagates); truncation of the lifecycle refuses exactly the unreachable window; enumeration and injection are deterministic (identical transcripts across repeats, JSON-serializable); -- negative/adversarial: unreachable window refused (WINDOW_NOT_REACHABLE, static + dynamic), duplicate-window catalog corruption detected (DUPLICATE_WINDOW / WINDOW_CATALOG_MISMATCH via monkeypatched WINDOW_ORDER and WINDOW_ANCHOR), duplicate/unknown/reordered/empty lifecycles refused, sticky crash and no double-record within one attempt, DOUBLE_FAULT never silent when no second crash occurs, malformed payloads refused with stable codes. 35 passed in ~0.4s; full evaluation/venue2027 suite 1412 passed; uvx ruff@0.7.1 check clean on both files; module self-check (python3 -m evaluation.venue2027.dsn.fault_windows) injects all five windows with exit 0. source_sha_after records the base commit 6fe5fe19 per sibling convention (DSN-X01, DSN-X02); the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report and reported in the handoff. Baseline parity NOT_APPLICABLE (injection controller layer; arms B0-B3 execute in DSN-X04..X06, kill driver is DSN-X07).
